body:
CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Card-battler experiment (BACKLOG.md SECTION 377/S378) shipped: founder green-lit 'lets experiment with making the hero cards based and if it ends up being unfun we bring back classic RTS/MOBA hero affordances in order to increase player agency' -- built as a toggleable, cheap-to-revert architecture, not a wholesale replacement. New ArenaHero.npc_controlled (default 0): when set, arena_update drives that hero via new arena_npc_hero_tick (a generalized, any-hero-index merge of the existing arena_bot_tick_heuristic/bot_cast_kit_if_ready practice-bot AI -- checked directly, both were already hero-index-agnostic in their real math, only their own wrapper hardcoded hero 1 vs hero 0) instead of expecting player input; apps/arena_server's PACKET_ARENA_MOVE/PACKET_ARENA_CAST handlers both gate on it. New packages/simulation/card_deck.h/.c: real Clash-Royale-style continuous Deck/Hand mechanics (one copy of every real card id -- the 16 existing ECOWAR_CARDS plus new CARD_ID_HERO_Q/_W/_R -- 4-card hand, play empties a slot and starts a real 3s redraw). New packages/simulation/card_battler.h/.c: per-owner registry, card_battler_play_slot resolves a generic card via the existing arena_ecowar_play_card unchanged, a hero-ability card via that hero's own existing arena_cast_q/arena_toggle_w/arena_cast_r -- zero new per-hero content authored, every kit reused as-is. 24 new tests (tests/test_card_battler.c), full suite green (3145 assertions). Not built: client UI wiring (no live call sites yet), balance pass. Real rollback path kept cheap by design: npc_controlled defaults to 0, every direct-control code path is untouched. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
